description: Raw material prices rise by about 8% from 2026-06 and stay higher. From the month the key customer cuts volume (event 4), lower volume pulls raw material spend down and hides part of the price effect, so this event is tested against the volume-adjusted (flexed) budget.
One-off emergency repair of a hydraulic press: one supplier invoice of DKK 350000 from Hydra-Service Danmark ApS.
Quarterly energy invoice booked in full in one month instead of one third per month, then reversed and rebooked correctly the following month. Overspend first, underspend second.
Key customer Nordvik Maskinfabrik A/S cuts volume by about 25%. Domestic revenue falls. Raw materials and packaging fall with volume, but that effect alone is below the threshold.
Sick leave in Production covered by extra overtime and temporary staff agency invoices. Wages are unchanged because sick pay is still paid. Size is the total of both accounts.
Many small purchases with generic descriptions push other external costs above budget. There is no single cause in the data; the correct conclusion is that the cause is unclear.
